title.zh: 接触机制：费米能级对齐后会发生什么
title.en: Contact mechanism: what happens after Fermi-level alignment

subtitle.zh: 电荷转移 / 能带弯曲 / 界面偶极 / 势垒
subtitle.en: Charge transfer / band bending / interface dipoles / barriers

body.zh: Φ_Bn ≈ Φ_M − χ。这是理想 Schottky–Mott 模型，仅用于理解趋势，不适用于所有真实界面。接触前，金属与 n 型半导体分开，分别标有 Φ_M、Φ_S、χ、E_F^M、E_F^S；接触后形成平衡界面、统一的 E_F，半导体侧出现空间电荷区（耗尽层）与电子势垒 Φ_Bn。能带标注 E_vac、E_C、E_V。
body.en: Φ_Bn ≈ Φ_M − χ is the ideal Schottky–Mott model, useful for trends but not valid for every real interface. Before contact, metal and n-type semiconductor are separate, labeled Φ_M, Φ_S, χ, E_F^M, E_F^S. After equilibrium contact, they share E_F and the semiconductor has a space-charge/depletion region and electron barrier Φ_Bn. Band labels include E_vac, E_C, E_V.

body.zh: 功函数差（Φ_M 与 χ、Φ_S 不同）→ 电荷重新分布（电子从低功函数一侧流向高功函数一侧，界面形成空间电荷）→ E_F 对齐（热平衡时金属和半导体具有统一费米能级）→ 能带弯曲/界面偶极（半导体侧能带弯曲，原子层偶极改变局部能级）→ 势垒形成（半导体侧电子势垒影响注入与传输）。
body.en: Work-function difference (different Φ_M, χ, Φ_S) → charge redistribution (electrons flow from lower to higher work function, creating interface space charge) → E_F alignment at thermal equilibrium → semiconductor band bending/interface dipoles that alter local energy levels → an electron barrier affecting injection and transport.

heading.zh: 03 真实界面偏离与 04 判断边界

body.zh: 界面态在禁带中引入能级，影响势垒；界面化学反应生成新相或化合物，改变界面能级与势垒；缺陷、空位、位错等引入局域能级并改变电荷分布；强界面态使费米能级钉扎，势垒对金属功函数不敏感。
body.en: Interface states introduce gap levels and affect the barrier; chemical reactions create new phases/compounds and change interface levels; defects, vacancies, and dislocations create localized levels and redistribute charge; strong interface states pin E_F so the barrier becomes insensitive to metal work function.

body.zh: 功函数差 ≠ 接触电阻：即使差大，接触电阻也可能很小（如高掺杂、隧穿）。势垒降低 ≠ 接触一定最佳：势垒过低可能导致反向漏电或可靠性问题。还需考虑半导体掺杂浓度、隧穿距离与界面厚度、界面损伤与缺陷。
body.en: Work-function difference is not contact resistance: a large difference can coexist with low resistance, for example with heavy doping/tunneling. A lower barrier is not automatically best: an excessively low barrier can cause reverse leakage or reliability problems. Also consider doping concentration, tunneling distance/interface thickness, and interface damage/defects.

body.zh: I–V：反向受势垒控制，正向受势垒与串联电阻影响。C–V：提取内建电势与势垒高度。温度依赖：ln(I) 对 1/T 的 Arrhenius 图提取势垒高度。TLM：分离接触电阻与片电阻。XPS：通过结合能测界面能带偏移与化学态变化。
body.en: I–V: reverse behavior is barrier controlled; forward behavior depends on barrier and series resistance. C–V extracts built-in potential and barrier height. Temperature dependence uses an Arrhenius ln(I) versus 1/T plot to extract barrier height. TLM separates contact and sheet resistance. XPS binding energies probe interface band offsets and chemical-state changes.

body.zh: 反馈动作：复测 → 区分势垒与串联电阻 → 联查界面。
body.en: Feedback: repeat measurement → distinguish barrier and series resistance → investigate the interface together.

body.zh: 理想 Schottky–Mott 关系是起点，不是所有接触的最终答案。
body.en: The ideal Schottky–Mott relation is a starting point, not a complete answer for all contacts.
